title: Primavera  (IS2026)
synopsis:
Early in the 18th century, the Ospedale della Pietà is the biggest orphanage in Venice, but it is also where the most talented orphans study music. Its orchestra is one of the world’s most highly regarded. 20-year-old Cecilia, an extraordinary violinist, has spent most of her life in the Pietà. Art has opened her mind, but not the doors of the orphanage. This is the only place she can perform, behind a grille, for rich patrons. That is until a wind of spring disrupts her life with the arrival of the new violin teacher. His name is Antonio Vivaldi.

 

David di Donatello Awards: Four Awards

Nastri d'Argento Awards: Three Awards

Toronto International Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
十八世紀初，威尼斯皮耶塔孤兒院的女子樂團名揚歐洲。然而，在才華洋溢的小提琴手Cecilia 眼中，這裡只是幽禁少女青春、急於安排她們嫁出去的牢籠。人人都讚嘆她的非凡琴藝，但她的宿命早已注定，戰爭結束後便要嫁給歸來的軍人。日復一日，她隱身柵欄之後，為貴族贊助者獻奏。直到新任小提琴老師宛如春日的狂風，劃破這座孤兒院的死寂，為被囚禁的命運奏響未知的樂章。他是韋華特。

意大利銀絲帶獎 三項大獎
